rows.qualification_required: B.Tech (AeroSpace Engineering) with First Class and with a minimum of proven track record of 2 years’ experience in Agricultural Drone Industry with minimum of 5000 acres spraying experience on versatile drones with DGCA RPC and must have working and operations knowledge and skill on different flight controllers. Must also possess use of LiDAR and Multispectral camera based UAV’s and their data acquis ion. Proven track record of designs, functional testing and flight data diagnostics etc. of drones and establishing drone start-ups for ushering incubation of drone entrepreneurs from APSARA with DGCA RPC and to design new agricultural drone systems to conduct various R&D programmes. Desirable: Should be ready to design and fabricate new drone systems required for agri and allied industries like Agro Forestry, Agricultural Extension, agricultural logistic drones etc.

Diploma in (Agriculture / Agricultural Engineering) with ANGRAU - ADITI Certification and DGCA RPC along with 4- wheeler driving license issued by RTA, Govt. of AP. Desirable: Conversant with farmers and farm requirements of agricultural drone technology related issues and skills, Should be ready to go to rural areas as and when the project requires as a part of technical programmes.

faq.question: Q1. What is the ANGRAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: ANGRAU has released a notification for filling 2 purely temporary and contractual posts of Drone Engineer cum Trainer and Drone Co-Pilot cum Driver for a period of 11 months.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in ANGRAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies notified under this recruitment.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for ANGRAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications by email is 14 October 2026 up to 5.00 P.M.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for Drone Engineer cum Trainer?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Tech (AeroSpace Engineering) with First Class and a minimum proven track record of 2 years' experience in Agricultural Drone Industry with minimum 5000 acres spraying experience on versatile drones with DGCA RPC, along with other specified technical skills.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification required for Drone Co-Pilot cum Driver?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Diploma in (Agriculture / Agricultural Engineering) with ANGRAU - ADITI Certification and DGCA RPC along with a 4-wheeler driving license issued by RTA, Govt. of AP.
